Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of Zimbabwe stride out in the middle. Paul Stirling and William Porterfield are the openers for Ireland. Blessing Muzarabani to start with the ball.
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then. Zimbabwe firmly in the driving seat but don't count Ireland out just yet as they have plenty of firepower in their batting lineup. The rivetting chase is coming up after the break. Don't go anywhere.

It was death by spin from Ireland in the middle overs. Simi Singh and Andy McBrine bowled in tandem and picked up three wickets between them, while also being very miserly. George Dockrell also came in and got the big wicket of Craig Ervine. Ireland, after the early breakthrough, struggled with the ball but pulled back things in the middle overs. The pacers had a day to forget though and Raza took them apart in the final ten overs. Andy Balbirnie might have missed a trick by not bringing on Paul Stirling or Harry Tector once the other two spinners bowled out, which cost them runs at the end and they have a stiff target in front of them to chase.

Zimbabwe will be delighted with what they have managed to put up on board. After being rocked early, Craig Ervine and Brendan Taylor counter-attacked the pace bowlers and the run-rate was more than run a ball. However, Taylor gave away his wicket on the very first ball of spin bowling and from there it was a different ball game altogether. Myers also fell and then Williams teamed up with his skipper to occupy the crease. However, runs were hard to come by and Williams also got out after being set. Raza then came in and the runs started flowing. Raza, along with the tail-enders, Madhevere and Jongwe hit more than a few lusty blows to end the innings on a high.

Sikandar Raza's blitz in the final ten overs has propelled Zimbabwe to 266 runs. Ireland will have to break the record for the highest successful run-chase on this ground to win this one. We are set for an exciting second innings.

OUT! Luke Jongwe is RUN OUT! Short in length, outside off. Raza slaps it to long off and runs across for a couple of runs. Andy Balbirnie there throws it to the bowler's end. Young collects it and disturbs the stumps. The third umpire has a view and it shows Jongwe was well out of his crease. Zimbabwe end at 266 for 7.
Umpire's review for a Run Out. Zimbabwe had to push for the second and Luke Jongwe is well short of his ground at the bowler's end and is Run Out on the final delivery.
Again serves it full and on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well played! A full on middle. Luke Jongwe whips it through backward square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off, a slower delivery. Luke Jongwe swings early and misses it completely.
DROPPED! A full ball, angling down. Luke Jongwe looks to heave but gets a top edge in the air and towards long off where the fielder spills it out. Two taken.
LEG BYE! A low full toss, angling on the pads. Raza misses his sweep and gets hit on the pads. They take a leg bye as it rolls on the leg side.
Who will bowl the final over? Craig Young to close out the innings.
Angles it onto the pads. Raza turns it to square leg and keeps the strike.
FOUR! Good shot! A full ball, outside off. Raza smashes it to covers for a boundary.
A length ball, slower on off. Luke Jongwe hammers it to long on for a single.
LEG BYE! Full and outside off. Raza goes for the scoop but gets hit on the body. They take a leg bye.
A low full toss, on off, drilled down to long off for a brace.

SIX! HUGE! A full ball, on middle. Raza hammers it all the way over wide long on for a biggie. The fielder in the deep steps in the rope before he flicks it in the ground. Also, 50 up for Sikandar Raza. Putting the finishing touches to the innings.
FOUR! Improvisation! A full ball, outside off. Luke Jongwe steps across inside the line and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary. 12 coming of this over.
A full ball, outside off. Raza looks to push but gets inner half of his blade to mid on for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Luke Jongwe dabs it to short third man for one more.
A length ball, on off, chopped on the off side. There was a slight hesitation but in the end they complete the single.
A length ball, on middle, worked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully played! A length ball, slower and outside off. Luke Jongwe opens the face of his bat and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Low full toss, on off and driven firmly by Raza. Paul Stirling is too casual at cover and the ball goes through his legs and into the fence.
Luke Jongwe walks out at number 8.

OUT! In the air..GONE! A back of the hand delivery, full on middle. Wesley Madhevere looks to heave it on the leg side but gets a leading edge, high in the air and towards long off. Andy Balbirnie in the deep, settles under it and takes a good catch as it was in the air for a while.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, outside off, cut away to point for a single.
WIDE! Spills it down the leg side. Raza misses his flick. Wide signaled.
A length ball way outside off. Wesley Madhevere steps down and slashes it to sweeper cover for one.
Around off, on a length, tapped to point for an easy single.
A length ball, on off. Sikandar Raza punches off the back foot through covers for two.

There is a slight halt in play. Wesley Madhevere got hit in the groin region on the last ball and is down on the ground. The physio is on the ground and Madhevere is now receiving treatment. We hope he's fine. We are ready to resume play and Mark Adair comes back into the attack.
Touch short, on middle. Wesley Madhevere hangs back and looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere makes room and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
A touch fuller, on off, Little removes the pace. Wesley Madhevere drives it hard but straight to covers.
On a length, on off, stays a bit low. Raza pulls it to deep backward square leg for one more.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Raza misses his flick. Wided.
Again serves a slow ball, short on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short in length, without much pace, outside off. Raza turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Josh Little comes in to replace George Dockrell.
Angles it on the pads, a full toss. Wesley Madhevere flicks it to deep mid-wicket and collects a brace.
FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, slower and on middle. Wesley Madhevere flat bats it over mid off and the ball races away to the dence.
A yorker-length ball, on middle. Raza digs it out on the off side and takes a quick single.
A length ball, outside off. Raza plays it late as he dabs it to third man for another couple of runs.
Angles it on the pads. Sikandar Raza tickles it fine to the fine leg region for two runs.
Length ball, on middle, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Craig Young comes back into the attack.
Angles it on middle, flicked to square leg for a single. 200 up for Zimbabwe.  6 overs remaining, can they reach to a score of 250?
Darted on the pads. Wesley Madhevere jams it out on the leg side.
Pitches it up, on middle. Wesley Madhevere slogs it to the wide of deep mid-wicket fielder. Two taken before the fielder cuts it off.
A full ball, on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Again a short ball, on middle, pulled away to fine leg for two.
FOUR! Nicely played! A short ball on middle. Raza pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep is committed as he charges in but the ball bounces in front of him and runs away to the fence.
Full on off, pushed to covers for a single.
THREE WIDES! A length ball, down the leg side. Raza misses his flick. The keeper fumbles to carry and the ball rolls to third man. Two runs taken.
Around off. Wesley Madhevere drives it to covers who fumbles a bit and allows the batters to steal a single.
Full on middle, eased down to long on for another single.
Beautifully bowled! A length ball, outside off. Raza looks to poke but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Quick single! A full ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to mid off for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere knocks it to backward point.
CHANCE! Dockrell gives some flight to this one as he bowls it full and on off. Sikandar Raza drives it aerially and to covers where the fielder carries it on a bounce.
A loopy ball, on off, driven abck to the bowler.
A flatter ball, on middle. Wesley Madhevere taps it softly on the leg side and scampers through for a quick single.
A full ball, on middle. Wesley Madhevere pushes it back to the bowler.
Wesley Madhevere comes in at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! George Dockrell strikes and that is the end of Craig Ervine innings! A short ball, on off. Craig Ervine makes room and cuts it straight to Andy Balbirnie at covers, inside the ring, who takes a good sharp catch leaning to his left. Another spinner finding the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b George Dockrell

Commentary.Commentary: A short ball, spinning in from outside off. Craig Ervine looks to pull but misses.
Slower and fuller, Raza nudges it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on the hips. Ervine hops back and tucks it behind square for a single.
Short ball, on middle. Ervine pulls it straight to square leg.
FOUR! Back of a length, on middle. Ervine steps out and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower delivery, pitched up on off. Raza comes forward and pushes it to point for a quick single. The shy at the non-striker's end doesn't hit and Raza carries on.
Length ball, on middle. Ervine hangs back and cuts it late to third man for a run.
A miscalculations from the umpire as George Dockrell bowls 7th ball of the over. It is full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated it up, very full and on middle. Raza does well to keep it out.
SIX! BANG! Fired in short and Raza picks up the length early. Raza pulls it behind square and over the ropes.
Flatter delivery, on off. Raza plays it to covers.
Dockrell pulls back his length and bowls it slow, outside off. Ervine gets beaten in flight and edges it to short third man for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky shot from Craig Ervine. This one is very full, on off stump. Ervine reverses and just deflects it behind for a boundary.
Dockrell starts with a full ball, on the pads. Raza gets it through mid-wicket for a single.
George Dockrell is brought into the attack.
A touch short and outside off. Ervine slices it to the left of backward point and gets a couple of runs.
Slower ball, full and on middle. Ervine pushes it to mid off.
Length again, on top of off. Sikandar Raza tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Raza taps it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length and outside off. Raza leaves it alone.
FOUR! Adair starts with a fullish delivery outside off. Raza just breezes it past extra cover and into the fence. Classy shot!
Mark Adair is back on.
Loopy ball, on middle. Ervine keeps it out. Andy McBrine ends with excellent figures of, 10-0-26-1.
Flatter delivery, on off and nudged to backward point.
Just short of a length and Raza cuts it to deep point for a run.
Nicely flighted on off and allowing it to turn. Raza watchfully keeps it out.
Tossed up, on off. Raza pushes it to mid off.
Slower delivery, around off and turning it. Raza gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Length ball, on off. Raza taps it beside his feet on the off side and sets off for a quick single.
FOUR! Little comes around the wicket and serves a half-volley outside off. Raza creams it through covers and gets off the mark in style.
Good-length ball, on off. Raza taps it to point.
Sikandar Raza walks out now.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Josh Little strikes right after the drinks break. He bowls an off-paced delivery on a length and around off stump. Williams just looks to steer it past backward point but gets an inside edge and the ball chops back onto the stumps. The partnership is broken and all the hardwork is undone. Josh Little has repaid the faith put in him by his captain.
Back of a length, around off and guided down to third man for a run.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Williams pulls it straight to mid-wicket, where Paul Stirling makes a half stop and keeps it to one.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe have cut through the phase of spinners and the runs have certainly dried up. Craig Ervine and Sean Williams are looking comfortable but someone has to change gears if they want to post a score above 250. Ireland will look for wickets and cut them down for a score as low as possible.
A touch shorter and on off. Williams makes room and cuts it past point for another single.

Slight hesitation but no damage done. Ervine pushes the fuller delivery to cover and sets off for a run. Williams stops and starts to run but the fielder fumbles and they cross over. And that's FIFTY for the skipper, Craig Ervine. He has played really well after loosing Taylor and will now look to up the ante.
Fullish ball, around off. Williams pushes it through covers for a single.
Slightly tossed up on middle and Sean Williams decides to take the aerial route. He slogs it past mid-wicket and picks up a couple.
Fired in on middle. Williams defends it out.
Flatter delivery, on off. Ervine works it past cover-point for a run.
A length ball, angling on the pads. Sean Williams looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams cuts it to the left of point where the fielder dives and stops it. Lovely piece of fielding.
On a length, on middle, Sean Williams nudges it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Hurls a full ball, on middle. Sean Williams pushes it gently wide of mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams looks to tap it on the leg side but gets a thick outside edge to the third man fence. The fielder from point runs across but to no avail.
Simi Singh (10-2-22-1) is done with his spell. Josh Little comes in to replace him.
Darted on the pads, tucked on the leg side. Runs have certainly dried up for Zimbabwe. They are not going after the spinners.
Touch fuller, angling on middle. Sean Williams drives it through covers for one.
Another single as this is pushed to covers. This was full and on middle.
Darted on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Just short of point! A short ball, outside off. Sean Williams hangs back and cuts it straight to point where the fielder dives forward but catches it on a bounce.
Tosses it up on middle. Sean Williams defends it off the front foot.
A full ball, on off, pushed through covers for a single. End of a brilliant spell from Simi Singh.
A flatter ball, on middle. Blocked out.
A loopy ball on middle. Craig Ervine advances down the track and looks to whip it but gets a leading edge, high in the air and towards long off where the ball drops safely. Single taken.
A full ball, on middle. Defended out.
On middle. Craig Ervine reaches to the pitch of the ball and goes for the sweep but mistimes it back on the deck.
Angles a full ball, on middle. Craig Ervine defends it off the inner half of his bat.
Touch short, on off. Sean Williams cuts it nicely but finds cover.
A flatter ball, on off. Kept out.
On middle, full ball, Blocked out.
Very full on middle. Sean Williams strides forward to defend it out.
Flatter on middle, drilled down to long off for one more.
Slight short, on off. Sean Williams rocks back and slaps it down to long off for a single.
Very full on middle. Craig Ervine prods forward to defend but does it with inner half of his bat to short mid-wicket.
Again serves it full on middle. Defended out.
Full angling on middle. Craig Ervine prods to defend.
Now stays back and defends this full ball under his eyes.
Comes down the track and turns it to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
Very full, on middle. Ervine plays it to long off for another single to end the over.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Williams pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller one, on middle. Williams digs it out to long off for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Williams defends it out.
Ervine drives the fuller delivery on off stump down the ground for a single.
Shortish ball, outside off. Williams cuts it off the back foot to deep point for a run.
Shorter delivery, on middle. Williams works it off the back foot to wide long off and retains the strike for the next over.
Fired in, full and on middle. Ervine drives it to long on for another single.
Flatter delivery, on the pads, tucked to short square leg.
Fuller delivery, sliding in on leg stump. Ervine nudges it to short mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Williams plays it to deep point for a run.
Angled in on middle and leg. Ervine with a push down to long on for one.
Tossed up again, on off. Ervine punches it to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery, on middle. Ervine defends it out.
A touch shorter, around off. Ervine nudges it to backward point.
Flatter delivery, cut away to the cover region.
BEAUTY! McBrine serves this one full, on off stump. Ervine leans in to block but gets deceived in flight and the ball just misses top of off.
Flatter one, on off and kept out.
Maiden over from Simi Singh. Shortish ball, on middle, punched off the back foot to cover.
Looped up, full and on middle. Williams plays it to mid off.
Tossed up, on off. Williams defends it off the front foot.
Round arm delivery, on middle and sliding in with the angle. Williams misses the push and gets hit on the pads. Simi Singh appeals but turned down.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Williams pushes it on the off side.
Very full and on leg stump Williams blocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, around off. Williams drives it past cover for a run.
Shortish ball, on off. Ervine rocks back and cuts it past point for another single.
Flatter delivery, angled in on middle. Ervine defends it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Williams pushes it down to long off for a run.
Awkward bounce again for the batter. Fullish delivery, outside off and the ball just pops up, bamboozling Williams.
Flatter one, on off. Ervine plays it to deep point for a run.
Very full on middle. Sean Williams solidly blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! A full ball, on middle. Sean Williams goes for the reverse sweep and hits it past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A flatter, quicker ball, on the bodyline. Sean Williams hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Waits in his action and serves a full ball, on middle. Defended out.
Angles it on middle now. Sean Williams prods to defend it out.
An arm ball, on middle, it skids through. Sean Williams pushes it to covers.
A flighted delivery, on off. Craig Ervine defends off the front foot.
Awkward bounce for Ervine as he looks to cut. Misses it completely.
Touch short, on off. Sean Williams knocks it to deep covers to get off the mark with a single.
Again serves a flatter ball, quicker and on off. Sean Williams looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the body.
A flatter ball, on off, pushed to covers.
Touch fuller, on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle, drilled down to long off for a single.
A full ball, on middle. Blocked out.

CHANCE! A full ball, on middle. Sean Williams turns it to short square leg. This time Craig Ervine wants a single but was sent back from halfway. The fielder throws it to the bowler who fumbles to carry it. Would have been a goner.
A full ball, on middle. Sean Williams goes for the reverse sweep and hits it to point. He wants a single but was sent back.
A shorter ball, this one lands and straightens up, outside off. Sean Williams leaves it alone.
Full on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Just a single! A flatter ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN!  Lovely delivery! Serves it short and outside off. Craig Ervine looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated on off. Ervine pushes it to covers.
Slightly shorter on middle. Craig defends it under his eyes.
A flatter ball, on middle. Craig Ervine flicks it to short mid-wicket.
A loopy ball, on off, pushed to point.
Another solid block from Sean Williams. Just a run coming from this over. Ireland getting their groove back.
On middle. Sean Williams strides and defends it to covers.
Tossed up, on middle. Sean Williams is solid in his block.
A full ball, on middle, driven back to the bowler who half-stops it.
Very full on middle. Sean Williams defends off the front foot.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to short square leg for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Sean Williams walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Andy McBrine, just like Simi Singh has picked up a wicket in his first over. Looped up delivery, on off stump. Dion Myers gets on his knee, looking to paddle it fine. He ends up getting a top edge and Lorcan Tucker takes a couple of steps to his left and pouches it comfortably. Spin seems to be doing the job on this tacky wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: A touch shorter and Ervine flicks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for a run.
This one is pushed through quicker and on middle and leg. Ervine looks to paddle but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flighted delivery, around off. Myers dabs it towards cover for a run.
A touch fuller, on middle. Ervine bunts it on the leg side and picks up a run.
Flatter delivery, on off. Ervine nudges it behind point.
So, spin from both the ends as Andy McBrine is into the attack.
A touch flatter and quicker, around off stump. Myers looks to cut but this one skids on and beats the bat.
Flighted delivery, around off. Ervine leans in and drives it past cover for a single.
Floated it up on off stump. Ervine blocks it out.
Tossed up again, on middle. Myers pushes it down to long on for a run.
Nicely tossed up, on off and this one turns a bit. Myers inside edges it onto the pads.
Floated delivery, on off. Ervine nudges it to backward point for a quick single. Good, positive running.
Pitched up and attacking the off stump. Myers digs it out to mid off.
Good-length ball, outside off. Myers leaves it alone.
Length ball, angled in on middle. Myers blocks it off the back foot.
Little comes from around the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off. The ball stays low and Myers misses the defensive shot. The ball dies on its way to the keeper.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off and angling away. Dion Myers carves it over point and into the fence for his first boundary of the day.
Length ball, angling on the pads. Ervine flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Fuller delivery, on off. Myers pushes it back to the bowler.
Myers gives the charge to the flighted delivery. He misses the drive and gets it off the pads towards the off side.
This one is tossed up and slower through the air, on off. Myers looks to block but gets a leading edge on the off side.
Flighted delivery, on middle. Ervine pushes it to covers for a quick single.
Tossed up delivery, on off. Ervine blocks it out.
Floated it up, on leg stump. Ervine nudges it onto the leg side.

DRINKS BREAK! Ireland's decsion to bowl first proved to be fruitful as they got Regis Chakabva early on. Then, Taylor and Ervine took the game to the bowlers and put up a 71-run stand. Just when it was all going good for Zimbabwe, Simi Singh got Brendan Taylor and the game now hangs in balance.
Slightly pitched up, around leg stump. Myers looks to flick but gets rapped on the pads.
Full and straight. Ervine pushes it to wide mid on for a single.
Length ball, angling in on middle and leg. Ervine tucks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full and wide delivery, shaping away even further. Left alone and a wide called.
LEG BYE! Length again, this time on the pads. Myers looks to tuck but misses. The ball hits the pads and roll onto the leg side. The batters get a leg bye.
Good-length ball, around off. Myers taps it to cover-point.
Little serves it on a length, close to off stump. Myers with an assured leave.
A full ball, on middle, drilled down to long on for a single. Dion Myers is off the mark.
A flatter ball, outside off. Dion Myers looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Tossed up, full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Touch fuller, outside off. Dion Myers tucks it to the leg side.
Shorter, on off, cut away to point.
Dion Myers comes in to bat at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Simi Singh strikes on the very first ball and gets the dangerous Brendan Taylor! A full ball, outside off. Brendan Taylor gets on his knee and goes for the slog-sweep. Does not time it well and hits it straight in the hands of George Dockrell who was patrolling at deep square leg. Finally, Ireland breaks the partnership as these two were scoring runs at good pace.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Simi Singh comes in to replace Josh Little.
Good comeback from Craig Young after going for a boundary on the first ball. This was on a length, outside off. Craig Ervine looks to push but fails to do it.
Pitches it up, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On a length, on middle, Blocked out.
Again angles it on middle. Craig Ervine pushes it to covers.
Goes wide of the crease and angles a length ball, on off, tapped to covers.
FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast for Zimbabwe! A full ball, on off. Craig Ervine leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.
SIX! First maximum of the innings! A full ball, on middle. Brendan Taylor stands tall and lofts it nicely, straight down the ground for a biggie. He is one run away from an half-century.
Around off, on a length, pushed to covers.
Angles it on the pads, this is flicked to deep backward square leg for a single.
WIDE! Little misses his line and spills it down the leg side. Ervine misses his flick.
On a length, outside off. Taylor carves it to deep point for a single. Smart Cricket!
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Brendan Taylor making batting look so easy! A length ball, outside off, bit of width on offer. Brendan Taylor slaps it through cover-point for another boundary.
A length ball, outside off, cut away to point for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Kept out. 10 runs coming of this over.
Very full, on off. Craig Ervine tucks it to square leg for a single.
Short in length, on off, tapped to third man for a single.
FOUR! A full ball, on middle. Brendan Taylor flicks it uppishly but clears short mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.

Ireland have taken the review for an LBW decision. This one seems to be close but the impact might just be outside off. UltraEdge shows that there is daylight between bat and pad. Ball-Tracker supports the umpire's decision and the impact is indeed outside off. Ireland lose their review and Taylor carries on.

NOT OUT! A length ball, around off, it lands and shapes in. Brendan Taylor takes a big stride forward to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge and gets hit on the pads. They appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Ireland take the review. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows impact is outside off and Ireland lose their review.
FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball, outside off. Brendan Taylor waits for the ball and dabs it late to third man. The fielder in the deep dives but flicks it back into the ropes.
Craig Young switches end and comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Good shot! Short in length, outside off. Craig Ervine punches off the back foot through point and the ball races away to the fence.
A short ball, on middle. Craig Ervine looks to defend but gets hit on the body.
Short in length, on middle, tucked on the leg side for a quick single.
FOUR! Releases the little bit of pressure straightaway. On a length, outside off. Taylor drives it through cover-point for a boundary.

NOT OUT! A length ball, it straightens up off the deck, outside off. Taylor looks to defend but gets square up doing so. The keeper, Lorcan Tucker catches it and appeals for a caught behind. The umpire takes some time before raising his finger. Taylor has a chat with his fellow partner and goes for the review. UltraEdge shows no bat and the decision is overturned. Brilliant review from Taylor, he was confident on it

Brendan Taylor takes the review straightaway. NOT OUT! UltraEdge shows that there was no bat involved, so it can't be caught behind and Ball-Tracker confirms that the impact was outside off stump. Taylor with an excellent review and he will carry on.
On a length, on off. Craig Ervine taps it in front of point. The fielder scores a direct hit at the keeper's end and allows a single as the ball ricochets to square leg.
Length ball, outside off and shaping in. Taylor leaves it alone. Zimbabwe are 47/1 at the end of the first Powerplay.
FOUR! Just a hint of width from Adair and Taylor doesn't let it go unpunished. He lofts the length ball outside off over cover and into the fence.
Length ball, outside off. Taylor isn't going to play at that one.
Pitched up, on off stump. Taylor bunts it to the cover region.
Back of a length, on off. Taylor shuffles a bit but manages to tap it back onto the deck in the end.
Full and wide outside off. Taylor leaves it alone.
FOUR! A bit too straight again from Josh Little. Ervine tucks it through square leg and into the fence. 12 off Little's first over.
Length ball, on off. Ervine stays solid in defense.
Short and wide. Ervine latches onto it and cuts it through point. Mark Adair cuts it off and keeps it to two.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Craig Ervine. Little serves it on the pads and Ervine flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a good length, on middle and leg. Ervine defends it off the back foot.
Drop and run. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Taylor dabs it on the leg side and sets off for a quick single.
WIDE! Little starts off with a loosener down the leg side. Taylor misses the flick. Wided.
Josh Little is into the attack.
FOUR! Exquisite cover drive from Craig Ervine. Pitched up, on off from around the stumps. Ervine punches it through extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Pitched up, on middle. Taylor wrists it to deep square leg for a single.
Full again and on the pads. Ervine flicks it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Fullish delivery, around off. Ervine lets it through to the keeper.
Full and straight and Taylor clips it well through mid-wicket. Andy McBrine gives chase and cuts it off, but the batsmen get three before Simi Singh throws it back.
Back of a length, around off. Taylor defends it off the back foot.
Good-length ball, just outside off. Ervine watchfully lets it go.
Length ball, on leg and shaping in. Ervine looks to tuck but gets hit on the pads.
Length ball, on the pads again. Taylor flicks it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Fuller delivery, angling onto the pads. Taylor clips it over mid-wicket and the ball races into the vacant boundary.
Pitched up on that fifth stump line. Brendan Taylor with another leave.
Length ball, outside off and shaping away. Taylor shoulders arms.
PEACH! Good-length ball, on off and angling away. This one straightens a bit and leaves Craig Ervine bamboozled.
Fullish delivery, around off and shaping away. Craig Ervine leaves it alone.
Full and on off stump. Ervine opens the face of the bat and plays it to point.
On a good length, on off and angling away. Ervine looks to play at it but gets beaten.
Slightly pitched up, on off. Taylor pokes at it and gets an edge down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Taylor rocks back and keeps it down on the off side.
On a length, slanting across, outside off. Left alone.
A full ball, angling down. Brendan Taylor flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Craig Ervine tucks it to mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
A full ball, outside off. Left alone.
Craig Ervine is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Craig Young strikes and gets the breakthrough! A length ball, outside off, hint of away movement as well. Regis Chakabva hangs back and looks to defend away from the body but gets a thick outside edge to the second slip where the skipper, Andy Balbirnie takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on off. Regis Chakabva punches off the back foot to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Brendan Taylor leaves it alone to the keeper.
A full ball, on middle, defended back to the bowler.

Lovely delivery! A full ball, outside off, it shapes in off the deck. Brendan Taylor prods forward to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. A mild appeal for LBW turned down. Replay shows there was a big inside edge.
On a length, outside off. Brendan Taylor shoulders arms to it.
Touch fuller, on middle. Regis Chakabva flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva turns it to short mid-wicket.
A touch fuller, on middle. Brendan Taylor nudges it to the leg side.
A length ball, on off. Brendan Taylor defends it to cover.
Length again, around off. Taylor taps it to cover-point.
Length ball, on off. Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Full again and drifting onto the pads this time. Taylor works it through mid-wicket and beats the chasing fielder from long on for a boundary.
Full, swinging delivery, on off. Well kept out by Taylor.
Big inswinger, starting from well outside off and ending around middle and leg behind the batter. Regis Chakabva with a classy leave.
Back of a length, on off and nipping in. Chakabva gets squared up and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Uppish but safe. Full ball, on off. Chakabva drives it on the up. The ball goes on the bounce to mid off.
Adair hits the length hard, on off stump. Chakabva hops back and taps it back onto the deck.
WIDE! Length ball, swinging down the leg side. Left alone and wide called.
A full ball, on off, pushed to mid off.
On a length, on off, tapped through the gully region for a single.
WIDE! Serves a length ball, shaping away, outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Mark Adair.
Beautiful delivery to end the over! A full ball, very full, on middle. Regis Chakabva gets his bat down on time to defend it.
NIcely played! Short in length, on off. Brendan Taylor hangs back and punches it through cover-point for three runs.
A full ball, on middle. Taylor looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

NOT OUT! A length ball, it lands and moves in, around off. Brendan Taylor gets on the front foot to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal but not given. Young convinces Andy Balbirnie for the review and he takes it. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows the umpire's call on wickets. So the on-field decision stays.

DROPPED! Chance gone begging! A length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge to the second slip where the fielder dives to his right but spills it out. A single taken.

Ireland take the review for an LBW decision. UltraEdge shows that there's no bat involved and Ball-Tracker shows that wickets are umpire's call. Brendan Taylor survives and Ireland don't lose the review.
WIDE! This one jags back in, on a length, down the leg side. Taylor misses his flick. Wided. The batters also sneak in a run as the keeper fumbles.
Young starts with a length ball, way outside off. Taylor shoulders arms to it.
We are ready for play. The Ireland players spread out on the field. Brendan Taylor and Regis Chakabva are the openers for Zimbabwe. Craig Young to start proceedings with the ball.
Th teams, along with the umpires stride out to the middle for the national anthems. The Zimbabwe national anthem is first, followed by Ireland's national anthem.

PITCH REPORT - Due to Covid restrictions, the pitch cannot be inspected from close on but the conditions are overcast and suited for bowling. The weather, however, has been brilliant in the past two weeks and the surface will still be good for batting and history supports this claim as the team batting first has won all of the last 12 matches here.

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe, says he would have bowled first as well and the batting at the top has been a bit disappointing and hopefully, they can make adjustments to it. He adds that the outfield is wet and Brendan Taylor and Sikandar Raza do come in along with a couple of others.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they will bowl first due to the overcast conditions and the wicket might be tacky. He adds that it will be tough and hopefully conditions will be in their favour and there are changes to the squad.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, William Porterfield, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Simi Singh, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Andy McBrine, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Josh Little.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor, Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Dion Myers, Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.
TOSS - Both the captains are out in the middle. Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland has the coin in his hand. He gives a flip and it lands in favour of Ireland. They have elected to bowl first!

UPDATE 10.22 am Local (9.22 am GMT) - As the inspection is underway, we can see the officials out on the ground. Even the Zimbabwe players are seen warming up. So, the news coming up is that the toss will take place at 10.30 am (9.30 am GMT). The match will start at 11.00 am (10.00 GMT)

UPDATE 10.08 am Local (09.08 am GMT) - Well, the news coming from the center is that due to a wet outfield, the toss has been delayed. An inspection will take place at 10.20 am. Stay tuned for further updates.

Hello and welcome to the first ODI between Ireland and Zimbabwe, live from Belfast. The T20I series provided tons of entertainment and Ireland, after being 1-0 down, won three in a row to clinch the series. Zimbabwe impressed with the ball in the final T20I but that proved to be just a consolation win and made it 3-2. The ODIs are important as crucial World Cup Super League points are up for grabs and both teams will be looking to make their mark. The toss and team news in a bit.
